name: Dr. Jane Smith
bio: Dr. Jane Smith is the Associate Dean for Research and Instruction at the University of Idaho Library and co-director of the Center for Digital Inquiry and Learning. Her research focuses on digital scholarship, fire lookout history, and community-engaged archives.

name: Dr. John Doe
bio: Dr. John Doe is a professor of Environmental History at Stanford University and author of 'Towers of Vigilance: A History of Fire Lookouts in the American West.' He has spent over two decades researching the cultural and environmental history of fire management.
presentation_title: Fire Lookouts in the Digital Age
presentation_abstract: This keynote explores how digital technologies are transforming our understanding and preservation of historic fire lookout structures.

name: Mary Wilson
bio: Mary Wilson is a digital preservation specialist at the University of Montana with expertise in photogrammetry and 3D documentation of historic structures. She leads the Montana Digital Heritage Project.
presentation_abstract: A presentation on emerging methods for documenting historic lookout structures using photogrammetry.

name: Robert Johnson
bio: Robert Johnson is the Regional Heritage Program Manager for the USDA Forest Service, Northern Region. He coordinates cultural resource management across five national forests.

name: Dr. Lisa Chen
bio: Dr. Lisa Chen is an assistant professor of Architecture at UC Berkeley specializing in vernacular structures and adaptive reuse. Her current research examines the architectural typology of fire lookout towers.

name: Dr. Maria Garcia
bio: Dr. Maria Garcia is a professor of American Studies at the University of New Mexico. Her research explores the cultural meanings of fire in the American West.

name: David Brown
bio: David Brown is the Oral History Coordinator at the Idaho State Historical Society, where he has led documentation projects on rural communities and public lands workers.
presentation_abstract: Exploring methodologies for collecting and preserving oral histories.

name: Susan Taylor
bio: Susan Taylor is President of the Forest Fire Lookout Association and has been involved in lookout preservation and restoration for over 25 years. She coordinates the national lookout registry.

name: Carlos Martinez
bio: Carlos Martinez is an associate professor in the College of Natural Resources at the University of Idaho. His research focuses on wildfire ecology and community resilience.

name: Emily Anderson
bio: Emily Anderson is a GIS analyst and PhD candidate at Boise State University researching the spatial history of fire management infrastructure in the Northern Rockies.
presentation_title: Mapping the Network: GIS Analysis of Lookout Sightlines
presentation_abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive GIS analysis of fire lookout sightlines across the Northern Rockies region.

name: Michael Nguyen
bio: Michael Nguyen is an oral historian and assistant professor at Washington State University. He specializes in labor history and environmental work.
presentation_title: Voices from the Tower: An Oral History Project
presentation_abstract: Presentation of findings from a two-year oral history project documenting lookout operators.

name: Dr. Priya Patel
bio: Dr. Priya Patel is a preservation scientist at Colorado State University studying the effects of climate change on historic structures in fire-prone landscapes.
presentation_abstract: Examining the challenges of preserving historic fire lookout structures in an era of increasing wildfire risk.

name: James Thompson
bio: James Thompson is a recreation manager for the Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forests who has coordinated volunteer restoration projects at historic lookouts.
presentation_abstract: A case study of community-led restoration efforts at the Coolwater Lookout.

name: Sarah Williams
bio: Sarah Williams spent 40 summers staffing fire lookouts across Montana and Idaho before retiring from the Forest Service. She now writes and speaks about her experiences.
presentation_abstract: A keynote address sharing four decades of experiences staffing fire lookouts.

name: Kevin Lee
bio: Kevin Lee is an architectural historian at the University of Oregon specializing in utilitarian structures of the American West.

name: Jennifer Moore
bio: Jennifer Moore is a historical architect with the National Park Service Pacific West Regional Office, specializing in the documentation and treatment of lookout structures.
presentation_abstract: Documentation and preservation challenges specific to the R-6 flat-style lookout towers.

name: Christopher Adams
bio: Christopher Adams is a professor of Construction Engineering Management at Oregon State University with expertise in historic timber structures.

name: Dr. Stephanie Clark
bio: Dr. Stephanie Clark is an associate professor of English at the University of Washington specializing in American nature writing and environmental literature.
presentation_title: The Poetics of Solitude: Lookout Literature
presentation_abstract: An analysis of how fire lookout experiences have shaped American nature writing.

name: Dr. Thomas Reed
bio: Dr. Thomas Reed is the Dean of the College of Art and Architecture at the University of Idaho.

name: Dr. Amanda Foster
bio: Dr. Amanda Foster is Associate Dean of the College of Natural Resources at the University of Idaho.

name: Mark Sullivan
bio: Mark Sullivan serves on the national board of the Forest Fire Lookout Association.
